comment: Example for easy_migrate.py. Copy it outside the Git repository, chmod 600, replace every placeholder. Relative paths are relative to the copy. Hooks run with /bin/sh in the work directory, with EASY_STEP, EASY_WORK, EASY_BUNDLE, EASY_SPI_DUMP, EASY_WIFI_VARS, EASY_HOST and EASY_PORT set (easy/README.md). 192.0.2.10 stands for the --host the bundle was built with; wlan0 for your Wi-Fi interface.

hooks.camera_ap_up: nmcli connection down id iblack-host-ap >/dev/null 2>&1; nmcli --wait 45 connection up id iblack-camera-ap
hooks.camera_ap_check: nmcli -t -f NAME connection show --active | grep -qx iblack-camera-ap
hooks.trial_ap_up: nmcli connection down id iblack-camera-ap; nmcli --wait 45 connection up id iblack-host-ap
hooks.trial_ap_down: nmcli connection down id iblack-host-ap; nmcli --wait 45 connection up id iblack-camera-ap
hooks.final_ap_up: nmcli connection down id iblack-camera-ap >/dev/null 2>&1; nmcli --wait 45 connection up id iblack-host-ap
